answers.workaround:
It will be used every time a new project is created (which, for people who are working on and testing bug fixes or features for Godot, will be often). I'm not aware of a way to change the Project Manager's Settings menu with scripts or add-ons.

Even if the functionality could technically be added with an add-on, it feels like a QoL addition that shouldn't require an add-on to achieve. By the time someone's gone to the trouble of finding an add-on to fix this problem, it would've been quicker for them to just open a project in the editor and make the change to their default project path via Editor Settings.

title: Add "Default Project Path" to Project Manager Settings
